title: claude-kit theme
description: One theme, with its name, mascot, welcome card tagline, status line palette and terminal colors. The folder that holds theme.json also holds claude.json, art.json and glyph/icon.png.

id.description: Folder name and Claude Code theme id (custom:<id>). Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

name.description: Display name, also used for the font family and the iTerm2 profile.

description.description: One sentence shown in the theme picker.

license.description: SPDX license of the theme's art, for example CC0-1.0. Use "personal" for art you may not share.

appearance.description: Whether the terminal background is dark or light.

char.description: The character the patched font draws as the mascot. Other fonts show this character itself, so pick an emoji close to the mascot.

cells.description: Terminal cells the glyph spans: 2 for an emoji, 1 for a narrow character.

tagline.description: The line next to the welcome card art. Write your own words.

palette.description: Status line colors by role. Text roles need 4.5:1 contrast against terminal.background and the icon needs 3:1.

accent.description: Branch name, approved PR, agent marks.

accent_soft.description: Commits ahead, staged files, agent types.

warn.description: Meters past the warning level, changed files, pending PR.

danger.description: Meters past the critical level, conflicts, failed agents.

caption.description: Labels such as context and 5h limit, and the welcome card tagline.

detail.description: Secondary text such as token counts and reset times.

track.description: The empty part of a meter bar. Decorative.

icon.description: The mascot where a terminal draws its outline in one color.

terminal.description: Terminal colors, written to the iTerm2 profile.

ansi.description: The 16 ANSI colors, in the order black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white, then their bright forms.
